folds.text: A **token** is a small piece of text, often a word or part of a word. Claude reads and writes in tokens.
The **context window** is Claude's desk for one chat. Everything in the chat has to fit on it.
When the desk is full, older parts get squeezed into a summary. Details can get lost, so restate anything important.

folds.question: Why do very long chats use up your limits faster?
options: Claude re-reads the whole chat each time
folds.why: Each new message brings the earlier chat along with it.
